metric_definition: Editorial synthesis of Pinterest's published creative benchmarks: video Pin ads average ~3.2x the engagement of static Pins and ~2.4x higher brand lift; video pins under 30s show 6.2x higher CTR and 4.8x higher save rate than static image pins in the same product categories. Not a keyword-specific numeric demand series.

Editorial synthesis: approximately 85% of Pinterest users watch video with sound off, so pins relying on voiceover/audio to carry the message underperform; Pinterest recommends 6-15 second videos with strong visual hooks and on-screen text/captions, vertical (9:16) or square framing. Not a keyword-specific numeric demand series.

Editorial observation: multiple established Pinterest-active competitors (e.g. Heritage Homestead, Hearth & Homestead) position ancestral/homestead-made tallow skincare as their core keyword angle, indicating this framing has active, discoverable search demand on Pinterest. Not a keyword-specific numeric demand series; used only to validate that the homestead/ranch-origin angle is search-relevant, not to copy any competitor's specific health claims.
